title: Adaptive q10 Relaxation Using a Low-Capacity Neural Network

governance.statement: 2024 evaluation outcomes were not used to select, tune, or modify the L2-EXP-11 formulation, architecture, or hyperparameters after pre-registration.

research_question: Can a low-capacity neural network learn WHEN q10 is unnecessarily pessimistic, and safely relax q10 only in those situations while retaining q10-level reliability?
core_hypothesis: Static q10 applies constant conservatism. An adaptive q-level selector can preserve q10 conservatism during high-risk regimes while relaxing to higher quantiles (up to q25) during low-risk regimes, reducing unnecessary diesel commitment and solar curtailment without sacrificing critical reliability.

model_specification.role: Adaptive q-level selector (NOT a solar predictor, NOT an EMS controller)
model_specification.target_definition: Normalized Downside Shortfall: s_t = clip(max(0, F_t - Y_t) / max(clearsky_t, 25.0), 0.0, 1.0)

selected_architecture.name: Arch-1 (16,)
selected_architecture.preprocessing: SimpleImputer(strategy='median') fit on 2020-2021 Train data followed by StandardScaler()
selected_architecture.selection_rationale: Achieved lowest validation MAE (0.13718), lowest MSE (0.03376), and highest R2 (0.4252) among candidate set while maintaining minimal parameter capacity (641 parameters).

simple_non_nn_baseline.purpose: Rigorous non-NN benchmark on identical features and target.

adaptive_q_mapping.formula: q_t = q_max - (q_max - q_min) * clip((s_pred_cal - s_low) / (s_high - s_low), 0.0, 1.0)
adaptive_q_mapping.safety_invariant: 0.10 <= q_t <= 0.25 strictly enforced at every hour

experimental_arms.Arm_B: Static q10 Conservative Lower Bound (Primary Reliability Benchmark)
experimental_arms.Arm_C: L2-EXP-10 Arm F (Corrected Priority: J_deficit > J_reserve > J_fuel > J_curt, with central charge replay fix)

acceptance_gates.gate_4_unmet_load: Realized unmet critical load: Arm D <= Arm B + 10% (64,005.6 * 1.10 = 70,406.2 Wh)
acceptance_gates.gate_5_reliability: Arm D reliability statistically consistent with static q10
acceptance_gates.gate_6_curtailment: Meaningful reduction in solar curtailment vs Arm B
acceptance_gates.gate_7_diesel: Arm D diesel does not materially increase vs Arm B
